uncited: It builds on [2D Gradient Estimation for Shading](10739-2d-gradient-estimation-for-shading.md) by adding a context-aware filtering step before gradient calculation.
- Input: A depth image $Z$ (distance from view plane to surface), where $Z(x, y)$ is the depth at pixel coordinates $(x, y)$.
- Depth image $Z$: A 2D array of floating-point values representing depth.
- Neighborhood $N_p$: A user-defined set of pixel offsets relative to the target pixel $p$.
**Locate Continuous Curvature Regions:** Identify pixels that belong to the same continuous curvature region.
**Estimate Gradient Components:** Compute the gradient components using only the selected valid neighbors.
- Time complexity: Depends on the neighborhood size and context checking overhead.
